tasks.title: Fix Exa MCP search integration (_search_with_exa)
tasks.description: Fix the Exa MCP call format. Current error: 'Input validation error: query received undefined'. Need to use mcporter's function-call syntax or --args JSON properly.
tasks.goal: Exa search returns valid results for QA queries
tasks.result: Implemented in search_sources() and _search_with_exa() with mcporter function-call syntax. Verified working with test query 'QA Engineer Berlin'.

tasks.title: Parallelize MASTER_SNAPSHOT LLM summaries (TODO 3.5)
tasks.description: MASTER_SNAPSHOT takes ~70 min (sequential LLM calls per vacancy). Implement parallel workers grouped by platform with sequential processing within each platform group.
tasks.goal: MASTER_SNAPSHOT completes in ~15-20 min instead of 70+ min
tasks.result: Implemented platform-based parallelization in recheck_published_rows(). Added PLATFORM_DOMAINS mapping (22 platforms), detect_platform(), group_by_platform() helpers. Recheck now groups rows by platform and processes each platform's batches in a dedicated worker.

tasks.title: Content-hash based skip for summary recomputation (TODO 3.6)
tasks.description: Extend LLM decision cache to include content hash of announcement text. Skip summary generation if content unchanged since last cycle.
tasks.goal: Repeated runs skip unchanged vacancies, reducing MASTER_SNAPSHOT time further
tasks.result: Already implemented in LLM decision cache (llm_decision_cache.json). Cache entries now include: URL hash, fetch_status, has_announcement. Cache invalidates when fetch succeeded but content invalid (200/304 with empty announcement).

tasks.title: Parallelize SYNTHESIS stage by platform (TODO 3.7)
tasks.description: SYNTHESIS stage processes all cards sequentially. Group cards by source platform and process in parallel waves.
tasks.goal: SYNTHESIS stage completes in ~5 min instead of 15-20 min
tasks.result: Implemented in synthesize(). Cards tagged with source_id from worker directories. Platform detection uses same PLATFORM_DOMAINS mapping. Cards grouped by platform, each platform processed in dedicated worker with sequential batches within platform.
